capabilities: Import a Flomo HTML export zip into notes
Sync memos automatically from a Flomo account
Customize the target folder for imported memos
Create a Flomo Canvas and Flomo Moments from imported memos
extras: Auto Sync requires Flomo authentication and depends on a pinned Playwright version installed manually with npx before first use; adhoc sync relies on Flomo's 'Export All (as HTML)' feature. Bi-directional links and merging memos by date are marked experimental in the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull memos out of Flomo, either by signing in and syncing or by converting Flomo's HTML export files.

relations.evidence: Make Flomo Memos to Obsidian Notes.

summary: Flomo importer that brings Flomo memos into Obsidian notes via automatic sync or manual HTML export import, with optional Canvas and Moments views.
